Connect Scanner

Send a digital scan straight to us

Connect your scanner once, then send every case directly from the software you already use.

WeTransfer

For large files, we recommend using WeTransfer — it's free and handles files of any size without compression.

  1. Visit wetransfer.com.
  2. Click the "+" button to upload your file (up to 2GB).
  3. Email to: videntallab@hotmail.com
3Shape
  1. Log in to your 3Shape Communicate account.
  2. Click Connections on the navigation bar.
  3. Click the Add Connection button.
  4. Enter videntallab@hotmail.com in the field and click Find.
  5. Select "Vidental Lab" in the result, then click Connect.
  6. Once we approve your request, the status of Vidental Lab changes from "Waiting for approval" to "Active".
Then, on your TRIOS scanner:
  1. Select Configure, then Lab Connections.
  2. Choose Communicate as the External Connection Method.
  3. Click Refresh and make sure Vidental Lab appears in your Communicate list.
Meditlink
  1. Log in to www.meditlink.com.
  2. Search "VidentalLab" to find us.
  3. Click the Request Partnership button and confirm.
  4. Once we accept your request, you can start sending us files.
To send a case to us via Medit Link:
  1. Head to your Case Box and click the case you want to order.
  2. On the Case Details page, click the Order button and fill in the Order Case form. Select VidentalLab as the partner.
  3. Click OK, then go to the Order Box to check the order has been listed.
  4. The order shows as Pending until we accept it.
iTero
  1. Log in to myiTero (administrator access is needed).
  2. Click the Settings icon on the main page and select Practice Settings.
  3. Click My Labs, then Add Lab.
  4. Search "Vidental Lab" and click Search.
  5. Click Connect next to Vidental Lab, then click Yes to confirm.
  6. Vidental Lab appears at the top of your list as Pending. It can take a few minutes, and once it changes to Connected you can select us in the Rx when sending a case.

Can't see the My Labs tab? Ask your practice administrator to add us or to give you admin permissions.

Manual Impression
  1. Fill in the Lab Slip with your practice, patient and appliance details.
  2. Have a digital scan (STL file)? Attach Digital Scan on the lab slip page, then submit your slip.
  3. Pack the impression, with the lab slip, ready for collection.
  4. Arrange a pickup by calling 0452 259 339 or emailing videntallab@hotmail.com.
